article.title: Control of income-tax authorities.
article.content: The Board may, by notification in the Official Gazette, direct that any income-tax authority or authorities specified in the notification shall be subordinate to such other income-tax authority or authorities as may be specified in such notification.
article.html:
118Control of income-tax authorities.

Section 118 · Chapter XIII · A.—Appointment and control · page 558 of the Act

The Board may, by notification in the Official Gazette, direct that any income-tax authority or authorities specified in the notification shall be subordinate to such other income-tax authority or authorities as may be specified in such notification.
